roles.Showcase: DMP's own look: white header, mixed-case headlines and rounded yellow buttons on light pages, with a home page that opens on a working keypad you can arm and disarm, six colour-coded zones and dark cinematic scenes
roles.Clean: a Swiss spec-sheet catalogue: white ground, hairline grid and mono labels, with a dimension-line hero, a product matrix and a panel finder, built for dealers and specifiers scanning for a product
roles.Press: an editorial magazine: serif headlines and photo covers, with a cover story, a contents page, voices from DMP's executives and fifty years of firsts told as a feature
